manifest.name: dsh-workspace-detached
manifest.description: Pop DSH workspace and session navigation into a separate Windows window, with grouping, logical drag-and-drop and activity/manual ordering.

scripts.pack:release: pnpm run check && pnpm test && pnpm pack --pack-destination dist

readme.text:
**把工作区与会话导航从 DSH 侧栏分离出来，放进可独立移动、调整大小的 Windows 窗口。**

[English](<README.en.md>) · [下载预览版](<https://github.com/liushimu/dsh-workspace-detached/releases>) · [反馈问题](<https://github.com/liushimu/dsh-workspace-detached/issues>) · [开发说明](<DEVELOPMENT.md>)

> 当前为 **0.2.3 预览版**。它是第三方独立插件，不是 DSH 官方功能或 Better Workspace 补丁。使用公开插件接口，不修改 DSH 主程序；卸载 Better Workspace 后仍可独立使用。“独立”指导航窗口和插件实现，并不表示可以脱离 DSH 单独运行。
主窗口保留聊天界面，工作区导航在独立窗口显示；聚焦一个工作区时，下方仍可预览其他工作区。聊天正文、费用、账户区域和部分无关标题已遮挡，界面布局未重绘。

总览同时展示多个工作区卡片，保留路径嵌套、名称分组、会话层级和活动状态。此图保留了提供者原先添加的隐私马赛克。

以上为用户提供并授权用于说明的真实截图；静态截图不是全部交互、显示器或系统组合的验收证明。

- **独立导航窗口**：从侧栏“弹出工作区”，在另一块屏幕或桌面位置管理导航；需要时“收回侧栏”。窗口不是第二个聊天后端，也不会因为弹出而新建 Agent。
- **保留层级与分组**：显示工作区、路径嵌套、名称分组和会话；支持总览、聚焦工作区及底部预览。
- **逻辑拖放与排序**：调整导航父级及同级顺序，选择按内容活动或手动排序；逻辑调整不搬动磁盘目录。
- **沿用 DSH 的会话动作**：选择、重命名、归档、移动等能力由主窗口对应服务完成；菜单是否可用取决于宿主能力与会话状态。复制项复制的是 **Session ID**，不是聊天内容。
- **适合长期开着的呈现**：搜索与折叠、可拖动的上下分区、默认标题字号区分、显式自定义外观，以及六格活跃点阵；系统要求减少动态效果时停用点阵动画。

- Windows x64。
- .NET Framework **4.6.2 或以上**。
- Microsoft Edge **WebView2 Evergreen Runtime**，需由系统或用户自行安装；插件不会自动安装系统运行时。
- DSH 声明兼容起点为 **0.2.1-rc.3**，Node.js **22.19 或以上**。宿主需提供公开的 Connection、webServer、subprocess、sessionProjections 与相关客户端槽位。

普通安装使用不需要 C# 编译器、Python、dotnet SDK 或 DSH 源码。其他操作系统的原生窗口暂不支持。DSH 仍处于接口演进阶段；版本声明和日常升级兼容的设计目标，不代表所有未来版本都经过实测。

1. 从 [Releases](<https://github.com/liushimu/dsh-workspace-detached/releases>) 下载 `dsh-workspace-detached-0.2.3.tgz`，不要把 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包当作安装包，也不必解压 tgz。
2. 若启用了 Better Workspace，先在 DSH 中停用它；两个插件占用同一侧栏位置，不应同时启用。
3. 在 DSH 的插件管理入口添加下载的本地 tgz，并启用 **dsh-workspace-detached**。不同宿主版本的入口文字可能不同，请以宿主实际插件管理界面为准。
4. 回到工作区侧栏，点击 **“弹出工作区”**。若新安装尚未被客户端加载，按宿主提示重新加载客户端。

也可在**目标配置的 DSH 宿主已停止**时使用官方 CLI，例如默认桌面配置：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-workspace-detached-0.2.3.tgz
```
请将配置名和文件位置换成实际值。不要在宿主或独立窗口运行时，直接覆盖其 node_modules、EXE 或 DLL。不要双击包内显示程序代替插件启动。

- **弹出／收回**：弹出后侧栏保留导航窗口状态入口；“定位导航窗口”找回已有窗口，“收回侧栏”结束该窗口的独立显示。
- **总览／聚焦**：进入一个工作区后，上方显示聚焦内容，下方预览其他工作区；可返回总览。
- **调整分区**：拖动中间手柄；焦点在手柄时，上下键微调，Shift 加快，Home/End 到边界，双击或 Enter 恢复默认。上下区域有最小高度；分区比例仅保留在当前窗口文档，新窗口恢复默认。
- **整理层级**：逻辑导航父级、名称分组、物理目录和会话归属不是同一件事。拖放调整导航层级不搬目录；菜单中的“移至工作区”则会改变会话运行目录，并在需要时提示确认。
- **活动时间**：活动排序以用户内容和非空助手回复为依据，不把工具事件、标题修改等管理动作当作新内容。部分历史会话的活动时间可能尚未补齐。
- **归档恢复**：可执行归档；恢复已归档会话请使用 DSH 主窗口／设置中宿主提供的归档管理入口，本插件不另设恢复管理器。

公开包名由内部开发名 `dsh-workspace-navigator` 改为 `dsh-workspace-detached`。内部偏好键、Cordis entry id、RPC、数据目录和原生资源文件名仍保留兼容名称，源码中见到 `workspaceNavigator` 或 `workspace-navigator` 属于有意保留，不是对旧包的运行依赖。

- **首次从旧候选切换**：先备份当前 DSH 配置并停用旧候选。安装新包前确认旧插件不再启用；若宿主报告相同 entry id 冲突，先通过官方管理器移除旧包，勿手改配置或清空数据。不要同时启用新旧包。此改名发布不宣称已完成所有宿主版本的自动迁移验收。
- **后续更新**：通过宿主插件管理器更新同名包；保留数据目录，不做热替换。
- **卸载**：先收回窗口，再用宿主插件管理器停用／卸载。插件不会删除工作区目录、会话或主动清扫偏好数据。

插件只提供导航与呈现，不创建第二套会话后端。会话管理动作通过 DSH 主窗口公开服务执行；不会直接修改 DSH 安装文件或读取 Better Workspace 的运行时 store/DOM。

原生程序仅加载包内固定 HTML/JS/CSS，通过受限的消息协议与所属主窗口通信，不提供任意网页、脚本、shell 或通用文件浏览入口。它使用的拖放不接纳外部文件或 URL。源码和发行包不包含维护者的私人配置、登录凭据或会话记录。

原生数据默认位于当前 DSH profile 的 `data/workspace-navigator`；WebView2 客户端缓存相互隔离，窗口几何偏好位于其稳定的 `window-state` 子目录。浏览器侧视图、标题缓存与 profile 配置的保存位置不同，改名不会自动扫描或导入 Better Workspace 的旧数据。

- 当前显示程序未做代码签名；Windows 安全或企业策略可能限制运行。请自行核验来源，不建议绕过系统策略。
- 原生窗口仅支持 Windows x64，不包含完整聊天界面；已有多个 DSH 主窗口的配套行为依赖宿主生命周期服务。
- 自动化覆盖了模型／协议、Host 生命周期、Native DOM/SVG/CSS 交互及包内容，但 **DOM 模拟不等于真实 WebView2 的物理点击、DPI、拖放或动画观感验收**。当前层级拖放、字体、分隔条及点阵的完整 GUI 组合仍待实际确认；不会把早期候选的测试当作当前版本全部通过。
- 没有跨所有 DSH 版本、屏幕布局、输入法和安全策略的保证。原生启动不可用时会报告问题，并尽量恢复主侧栏，不提供另开普通网页的替代后端。

反馈时请提供 DSH/插件版本、Windows 与 WebView2 版本、复现步骤和必要截图。请先遮盖路径、会话标题、聊天内容和凭据。公开截图请仅保留愿意分享的演示信息；不要上传未经脱敏的私人工作区截图。

参见 [开发说明](<DEVELOPMENT.md>)、[更新记录](<CHANGELOG.md>)、[MIT 许可证](<LICENSE>) 与 [第三方许可说明](<THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md>)。

分组及侧栏逻辑改编自 [KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace](<https://github.com/KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace>)；固定导航实现基于 DeepSeek Harness 的本地原型；活跃点阵改编自 [NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams](<https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams>) 的 WorkGlyph。原生包保留 Microsoft WebView2 SDK 再分发许可。这些复用不构成对 Better Workspace 或 AgentTeams 的运行依赖，也不表示原作者或 DSH 官方为本插件背书。

**Move workspace and session navigation out of the DSH sidebar into a separate, movable and resizable Windows window.**

[简体中文](<README.md>) · [Preview downloads](<https://github.com/liushimu/dsh-workspace-detached/releases>) · [Issues](<https://github.com/liushimu/dsh-workspace-detached/issues>) · [Development guide](<DEVELOPMENT.md>)

> **0.2.3 preview.** This is an independent, third-party plugin, not an official DSH feature or a patch to Better Workspace. It uses public plugin interfaces and does not modify DSH Core. Better Workspace and AgentTeams are not runtime dependencies. The window still requires a running DSH host: it is not a standalone chat application.

The main window keeps the conversation while workspace navigation lives in its own window. A focused workspace is shown above previews of the others. Conversation content, financial figures, the account area and some unrelated titles are covered for privacy; the layout has not been redrawn.

The overview shows multiple workspace cards, retaining path nesting, name groups, session hierarchy and activity indicators. The provider's existing privacy mosaics are retained in this image.

These real screenshots were provided and approved by the user for documentation. Still images are not acceptance evidence for every interaction, display or system combination.

- Detach workspace navigation into its own Windows window and return it to the sidebar when needed.
- Keep workspace nesting, name groups and sessions in one hierarchy, with overview, focused-workspace and bottom-preview views.
- Organize logical navigation parents and choose content-activity or manual sibling ordering without moving physical directories.
- Use the main window's session-management services. Menu availability follows the host and session state. The copy action copies the exact **Session ID**, not chat contents.
- Search and collapse rows; resize the focused/preview split; distinguish default group and session typography; retain explicit appearance settings.
- Show a six-square activity glyph, with staggered opacity animation and a static reduced-motion presentation.

Windows x64, .NET Framework 4.6.2 or later, and the system-installed Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime. The plugin does not install system runtimes. Normal use requires neither a C# compiler nor Python, dotnet SDK or a DSH source checkout.

The declared DSH floor is `0.2.1-rc.3`, with Node.js `22.19` or later and the required public Connection, webServer, subprocess, session-projection and client-slot capabilities. These interfaces are evolving: the version declaration is not a promise that every future DSH release has been tested. Other native-window platforms are not currently supported.

1. Download `dsh-workspace-detached-0.2.3.tgz` from [Releases](<https://github.com/liushimu/dsh-workspace-detached/releases>). Do not use GitHub's automatic Source code archive as the install package; do not unpack the tgz.
2. Disable Better Workspace if enabled. Both plugins occupy the same sidebar position and should not run together.
3. Add the local tgz through the DSH plugin manager and enable **dsh-workspace-detached**. Exact menu labels vary by host version.
4. Use **Pop out workspaces** in the sidebar. If necessary, reload the client as instructed by the host.

Alternatively, with the target profile's DSH host **stopped**, the official CLI can install the package. For the usual desktop profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-workspace-detached-0.2.3.tgz
```

Adjust the profile and path to your environment. Never hot-replace package files, EXE or DLLs while the host or detached window is running, and do not double-click the native carrier as an alternative to plugin startup.

Locate an existing detached window or return it to the sidebar through the corresponding controls. In focused view, drag the horizontal separator between the workspace tree and other-workspace previews. With the separator focused, arrow keys adjust the split, Shift changes it faster, Home/End move to its bounds, and Enter or double-click resets it. Both regions retain minimum heights; the ratio belongs to the current window document and resets in a new window.

Logical parent changes do not move files or change session ownership. The explicit **Move to workspace** session action is different: it changes the session working directory through the host and shows confirmation when required. Content-activity ordering counts surfaced human messages and nonempty assistant responses, not administrative or tool-only events. Some historical activity times can be unavailable.
Archiving is available; use the host's main-window/settings archive management to restore archived sessions. The plugin does not add another restore manager.

readme.section: Updates and the former development name
readme.text: The public package is renamed from the internal candidate `dsh-workspace-navigator`. Existing `workspaceNavigator` preference/projection keys and `workspace-navigator` entry id, RPC, data directory and native resource filenames intentionally remain unchanged. They are not a dependency on the old package.

readme.section: Updates and the former development name
readme.text: For an initial switch from the old candidate, back up the DSH profile and disable the old package first. Do not enable old and new packages together. If the host reports a duplicate entry id, remove the old package through the official manager before adding the new one; do not clear preferences or hand-edit the profile. This release does not claim a universally tested automatic rename migration.

readme.section: Updates and the former development name
readme.text: For later updates, use the host's manager and retain the data directory. To uninstall, return the window to the sidebar, then disable/remove the plugin through the manager. The plugin does not delete workspace directories, sessions or preference data.

The native carrier loads only its packaged HTML/JS/CSS and uses a restricted message protocol with its owning main window. It is not a general browser, shell, file browser or second chat backend, and it does not accept external-file/URL drops. The repository and release payload exclude the maintainer's private configuration, credentials and conversation records.

Native state defaults to the current DSH profile's `data/workspace-navigator`, with per-client WebView2 caches and a stable `window-state` directory for geometry. Browser view preferences and profile configuration have separate owners. This rename does not scan or import Better Workspace data.

The native carrier is currently **unsigned**; Windows or enterprise policies may prevent execution. Verify the source and do not bypass system policy. Automated model, protocol, lifecycle, DOM/SVG/CSS and payload checks are not physical WebView2, DPI, drag-and-drop, clipboard or animation acceptance. The latest hierarchy/splitter/typography/glyph combination still needs real GUI confirmation. Earlier-candidate evidence is not a full acceptance claim for this release.

There is no all-versions, all-display-layouts or all-input-method guarantee. Native startup failure is reported and the main sidebar is restored where possible; there is no alternate browser-window backend. Only share screenshots containing demonstration details you intend to make public. When reporting an issue, include relevant versions and reproduction steps, and redact paths, session titles, conversation content and credentials.
See [DEVELOPMENT](<DEVELOPMENT.md>), [CHANGELOG](<CHANGELOG.md>), [MIT license](<LICENSE>) and [third-party notices](<THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md>).

Grouping/sidebar code is adapted from [KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace](<https://github.com/KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace>); the fixed navigator implementation is based on a DeepSeek Harness local prototype; the activity glyph adapts the WorkGlyph from [NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams](<https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams>). The native payload retains the Microsoft WebView2 SDK redistribution license. Reuse implies neither a runtime dependency on those feature plugins nor endorsement by their authors or DSH.
